svg.aria-label: Adoption mode check across osf.toml readers
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Adoption mode check across osf.toml readers
svg.desc: Every reader of a repository's own osf.toml now funnels through `config::repo_document`, which parses the file and checks the adoption_mode key. The layered load and the gate share the same parser.
